scope: P7-015 current-process usage collection and ownership accounting only
identity_note: The amended consumer is a working-tree change at review time. File hashes bind this decision; the head commit alone does not bind the amendment.

findings.problem: Boolean full_task_acceptance/full_p7_015_complete changed into nonempty review-status strings, which can evaluate true in existing consumers.
findings.resolution: Both retain false; separate review_status carries human review state.

findings.problem: server_tree.separate_processes=false omitted temporary probe/indexing children, while RUSAGE_SELF excludes child usage.
findings.resolution: Specific separate_server_or_provider_process=false; child_process_usage=null; transient git/probe children explicitly unmeasured.

checks.name: self_identity
checks.reason: RUSAGE_SELF selects the calling process directly; numeric /proc PID lookup remains a separately named raw observation.

checks.name: ffi_initialization
checks.reason: MaybeUninit<libc::rusage> is read only after getrusage returns success; target libc layout selected by compiler; no manual ABI struct.

checks.name: cpu_time_units
checks.reason: timeval sec*1e9 + usec*1000 uses checked operations, rejects negative values, rejects non-normalized usec>=1e6 and overflow.

checks.name: peak_residency_units
checks.reason: Existing high_water_bytes maps Linux KiB via checked*1024 and macOS bytes unchanged; name and method identify lifetime high-water, not stage/current RSS.

checks.name: unsupported_platforms
checks.reason: Linux/macOS are explicit cfg; unsupported OS returns None and consumer emits unavailable rather than fabricated zero. Windows implementation not claimed.

checks.name: single_owner_no_double_count
checks.reason: runner/CodeIndex/fake provider listed under one shared_process_owner; server has no separately numeric total; raw_sampler/raw_process_snapshot not summed with owner.

checks.name: cpu_delta_scope
checks.reason: Assertions establish nondecreasing cumulative CPU for the same calling PID; no percent-utilization, component split, per-stage RSS delta, or kernel peak reset claimed.

checks.name: truthful_completion_schema
checks.reason: Both existing completion fields are boolean false, with independent review_status.

checks.name: child_process_boundary
checks.reason: Child usage is null with explicit exclusion; no full-tree claim is inferred from server/provider being in process.

limitations: No independent Rust execution in this review; root owns the fresh shared-target build.
Linux/macOS unit formulas reviewed; macOS runtime behavior not executed here.
SELF excludes transient children and does not measure the complete process tree.
No new performance SLA, statistical effect, resource isolation or full P7-015 completion decision.
